entities.summary: Shiri Maimon (b. 1981-05-17, Kiryat Chaim) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kiryat Chaim and Israel. Known in the fields of israel, composers & musicians, asia.
